name: AmbuVet pet ambulance
neighborhoods: All five boroughs; dispatched from NYC, tri-state pickups
region_note: PET AMBULANCE - 24/7 transport to a vet, from the Mayor's Alliance emergency vet list (2026-11-03), confirmed on its own site that day
notes: A 24-hour pet ambulance for getting an animal to a vet when you cannot take it yourself. Its drivers are licensed veterinary technicians, and its vehicles carry stretchers and oxygen. Emergency rides at any hour; non-emergency rides 9am to 8pm. It also carries animals that have died, and large or aggressive animals. It is not a hospital: ring the vet hospital you are going to before pickup, as AmbuVet's own page asks. It charges for each trip, payment due at pickup or drop-off, and dispatch is first come, first served, so at busy times it may point you to a partner first. An owner is not guaranteed a ride along with the animal.
type_raw: 24/7 pet ambulance - transport to a vet, not a hospital; operated by a licensed veterinary technician
